name: Ad creation
blurb: Briefs, hooks, ad copy, statics, UGC and AI video ads for Meta, TikTok and Google, plus teardowns and testing.
searches: Meta ads creative best practices new Andromeda update
TikTok ad hook formats performing this month
AI generated product video ad workflow new model
agent skill ad copy generation Claude marketing
creative testing framework paid social fatigue

tests.prompt: Write a Google Responsive Search Ad for a bookkeeping app for freelancers that auto-categorises bank transactions (14-day free trial, landing page headline: "Your books, done while you work"). I have no customer stats.
tests.good: 15 distinct headlines each 30 characters or fewer and 4 descriptions each 90 or fewer, with counts shown; mix of keyword, benefit, CTA and brand lines; every line usable alone; no invented numbers or #1 claims ([NEED: ...] flags instead); echoes the landing-page promise and trial; no AI-tell patterns; pinning advice.

tests.prompt: Plan five 9:16 TikTok/Reels ad concepts for a reusable silicone food bag brand. I have 60 reviews; the most common complaints they mention are plastic waste and freezer burn.
tests.good: Concepts built as segment x motivation x angle x format with quotes or placeholders tied to the reviews; each hook specifies visual action, spoken line and caption that don't duplicate; on-ramp continues the hook; text inside the 720x1200 safe band; mix of creator formats; a success metric and a one-variable test plan; no fabricated claims.

tests.prompt: Our Meta ads' CTR dropped from 1.4% to 0.7% over three weeks while frequency rose to 4.2. Here are 6 ads with thumbstop, hold rate, CTR and CPA. What should we do next?
tests.good: Diagnoses fatigue from the time series (frequency up, CTR down), reads the funnel per ad to find the weak stage, judges concepts not single ads, proposes new hooks/first frames and new formats rather than near-duplicates, keeps one variable per test, sets minimum data thresholds, and logs learnings.

tests.prompt: We sell a $49 anti-fatigue standing-desk mat. From our 120 reviews, write three Meta feed ad concepts with copy, rewrite the landing page hero so it matches them, and tell me how we'll know after two weeks whether the winning ad really won and isn't just noise.
tests.good: States a short plan first: concepts and copy here (creative-strategy.md, ad-copywriting.md, meta-ads-creative.md, testing-iteration.md), the hero through content-creation (conversion-copy.md: headline and CTA echo the ads' main claim, no invented proof), the readout through data-analysis (experiments-causal.md, statistics.md: one primary metric and the sample size fixed before launch, the difference reported with a confidence interval). Grounds each angle in quoted reviews; primary text front-loaded within 125 visible characters with counts; runs the copy validator; message-match map; one variable per test; checks the Done means of all three crafts.
